edits.before: E the contact, detonate, passive-auto, bank the Q visibly — the chip is free and the threat governs.
edits.after: Save Prismatic Barrier for the moment he commits to his R channel or an E stun combo — burning it early on chip poke leaves the all-in window unanswered.

edits.before: Q-poking on cooldown until the hook learns the rhythm — the binding is the lane's law; spend it like one.
edits.after: Standing next to your ADC lets one Eye of Destruction (W) hit both of you for the bonus center damage and slow — spread out before he casts.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and the artillery never converts. It writes your spacing rules. - W Prismatic Barrier is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Xerath Shocking Orb (E, Stun): 11-13s cd — his only CC; dodge it and the artillery never converts to a kill. - His R (130/115/100s cd) is an interruptible channel — a landed Q cancels it outright. - Your W is 10-12s — save it, don't season trades with it.

edits.before: Ahead, own the geometry: chip Xerath's duo per wave and laser the recovery roots.
edits.after: Ahead, punish his R on sight: Rite of the Arcane is a channel and your Light Binding cancels it outright — a landed Q ends the barrage and opens the dive.
